overview.title: Stablecoin native model
overview.summary: Arc is built around stablecoins as first-class assets, with USDC as the native gas token, EURC for euro-denominated transfers, and USYC for yield-bearing use cases.

overview.title: Stable fee design
overview.summary: Arc's fee market uses EWMA-smoothed base fees denominated in USDC and minimal priority fees, keeping transaction costs predictable and resistant to short-term demand spikes.

overview.title: Deterministic finality and settlement
overview.summary: Arc's deterministic finality delivers irreversible transaction settlement in under one second.

overview.title: System overview
overview.summary: Arc separates consensus from execution across two layers: Malachite orders and finalizes blocks, Reth processes transactions and maintains state.

overview.title: Opt-in privacy
overview.summary: Arc Privacy Sector (APS) is Arc's confidential execution environment for Solidity contracts, running alongside the public EVM with synchronous composability and default-deny contract isolation.

overview.title: Post-quantum security
overview.summary: Arc's post-quantum roadmap covers wallet signatures, validator authentication, private state, and supporting infrastructure against quantum-era attacks.
